## Posts
- [How to Create an Event Landing Page in WordPress](https://siteorigin.com/event-landing-page-wordpress/): The Landing Page Addon in SiteOrigin Premium displays a page without your theme's header, footer or sidebars\. In this walkthrough, we'll build a registration page for a one\-day printmaking workshop, with the event details, an instructor introduction and a registration form\.
- [How to Style One Page with the Custom Body Class Addon](https://siteorigin.com/custom-body-class-how-to/): Follow one example from start to finish with the Custom Body Class Addon: a dark header on a booking page, a fall accent on every page, and the classes for the homepage and shop page\.
- [Target Any Page with the Custom Body Class Addon](https://siteorigin.com/custom-body-class-addon/): Add your own classes to the page body, site\-wide or for a single page, and target them with CSS\.
- [Page Builder vs the Layout Block vs Widget Blocks](https://siteorigin.com/page-builder-vs-layout-block-vs-widget-blocks/): Page Builder, the Layout Block and Widgets Bundle blocks compared, for sites using the Classic or Block Editor\.

- [Influence](https://siteorigin.com/themes/influence/): Content Blogging Refined
